name: General Radiance Field Rendering via MLP
aliases: MLP Radiance Field with Aggregated Features
definition: An MLP predicts RGB values and volumetric density for a 3D point using its aggregated feature vector and viewing direction, forming a general radiance field.
summary: General Radiance Field Rendering via MLP trains an MLP to predict density and color using aggregated 3D point features instead of raw coordinates, enabling novel view synthesis from 2D images without 3D ground truth.
